name: Simple Template: Tribune (CR +0)
body:
Tribunes are imitations of exemplars created by deities or those who would impersonate deities. Though they lack the insight or experience of exemplars, tribunes often bear a fragment of their masters’ divine power. This template can be applied to any angel, archon, axiomite, azata, daemon, demon, devil, inevitable, psychopomp, or protean which does not have the exemplar template.

Rebuild Rules: Choose a single cleric domain. The tribune gains the abilities of the chosen domain as a cleric of their Hit Dice. By spending a use of one of their spell-like abilities which is not constant or usable at-will, the tribune may use one spell from the chosen domain as a spell-like ability so long as the chosen spell is not of a higher level than the expended spell-like ability (for the purpose of calculating a spell’s level, use its level on the cleric spell list, or the highest level if the spell is not on the cleric spell list). The tribune must provide any expensive material components required for using these spell-like abilities as if they were spells.

The tribune may expend the use of a spell-like ability as a free action to gain the benefits of that domain as if they were a cleric of a level equal to twice the level of the spell expended for a number of rounds equal to their caster level.
